from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """A financial entry extracted from a single company's filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as registered in the filing")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact text label of the line item (e.g. 'Accounts payable')")
    amount_value: str | None = Field(description="The numerical amount as written in the document (e.g. '70,257')")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the unit, e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_records: list[FinancialRecord]
